title: The Rise of Artificial Intelligence in Global Financial Services
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Rise of Artificial Intelligence in Global Financial Services
detail.abstract: This paper examines the rapid adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) across global financial services, analysing its drivers, impacts, and the attendant challenges. In recent years, most leading banks and financial firms have launched AI initiatives, reflecting a fundamental shift in how services are delivered. AI-powered tools are driving productivity gains, cost savings and new products-for example, a Money20/20/Acrew Capital report found that roughly 76 % of major financial institutions had announced AI initiatives by late 2024. Major banks report substantial benefits: JPMorgan Chase estimates its AI tools have already saved about $1.5 billion and boosted wealth sales by ~20 %, while Citi projects that AI could add ~9 % ($170 billion) to global bank profits by 2028. These developments have prompted central banks and regulators to pay close attention (the BIS, for example, urges central banks to "harness [AI's] power to monitor data in real time" for sharper inflation forecasts). At the same time, experts warn of risks-from job disruption to cyber threats and concentration in a few Big Tech providers. This paper synthesises recent evidence on AI in finance, drawing on industry reports and regulator analyses, to present a clear, policy-relevant narrative of this transformative trend. The conclusion argues that while AI offers banks a path to greater efficiency and innovation, robust governance and oversight will be essential to manage systemic and consumer risks as the technology diffuses.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了AI在全球金融服务的快速应用，探讨了其驱动因素、影响和挑战，强调AI带来的效率提升和创新机遇，同时指出需要强有力的监管来管理系统性风险。
AI.research_question: 人工智能在全球金融服务中的快速应用带来了哪些驱动因素、影响和挑战？
AI.motivation: 近年来大多数主要银行和金融机构都启动了AI计划，反映了服务交付方式的根本性转变，需要系统分析这一变革趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术创新扩散理论和金融科技监管框架，分析AI在金融领域的应用模式和影响机制。
AI.method: 综合行业报告和监管机构分析，对AI在金融领域的最新证据进行系统性综述。
AI.findings: AI工具带来显著效益：摩根大通节省15亿美元，财富销售增长20%；花旗预计到2028年AI可为全球银行增加1700亿美元利润；但同时也存在就业冲击、网络威胁和技术集中风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了AI在金融服务中应用的综合分析框架，为理解技术变革对金融体系的影响提供理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供清晰的监管建议，强调在追求效率创新的同时需要建立稳健的治理和监管体系来管理风险。

title: Algorithmic Criminal Liability in Greenwashing: Comparing India, United States, and European Union
affiliations: Guru Nanak Dev University and Guru Nanak Dev University

detail.title: Algorithmic Criminal Liability in Greenwashing: Comparing India, United States, and European Union

publicationDetails.detailsText: HPNLU Journal of Law, Business and Economics, Volume 3, No. 2024. Pp. 51–68.

detail.abstract: AI-powered greenwashing has emerged as an insidious challenge within corporate sustainability governance. It exacerbates the opacity of environmental disclosures. It subverts regulatory oversight. This study conducts a comparative legal analysis of criminal liability for AI-mediated greenwashing across India, the US, and the EU. It exposes doctrinal lacunae in attributing culpability when deceptive sustainability claims originate from algorithmic systems rather than human actors. Existing statutes exhibit anthropocentric biases by predicating liability on demonstrable human intent, rendering them ill-equipped to address algorithmic deception. The research identifies a critical gap in jurisprudential adaptation, as prevailing fraud and environmental statutes remain antiquated vis-à-vis AI-generated misrepresentation. Utilising a doctrinal legal methodology, this study systematically dissects judicial precedents, statutory instruments, and regulatory directives, yielding promising results regarding the potential expansion of corporate criminal liability doctrines. Preliminary findings underscore the viability of strict liability models, the recalibration of corporate governance frameworks to incorporate AI accountability, and the institutionalisation of algorithmic due diligence mandates under ESG compliance regimes. Comparative insights reveal jurisdictional disparities in corporate culpability paradigms, with the EU Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive (CSDDD) offering a potential transnational model for regulatory harmonisation. This study contributes to the discourse on AI ethics and environmental jurisprudence by advocating for a hybrid liability framework that integrates algorithmic risk assessment with legal personhood constructs. The implications necessitate a doctrinal evolution that fortifies juridical architectures against AI-driven environmental deception. The findings advocate for an interdisciplinary approach to AI regulation, ensuring algorithmic opacity does not preclude liability enforcement in sustainability-related misrepresentation.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过比较法律分析，揭示了AI驱动的绿色清洗在印度、美国和欧盟的刑事责任认定中存在法律空白，现有法律因人类中心主义偏见而无法有效应对算法欺骗，提出了严格责任模式和算法尽职调查等解决方案。
AI.research_question: AI介导的绿色清洗在不同司法管辖区（印度、美国和欧盟）的刑事责任认定存在哪些法律空白和挑战？
AI.motivation: AI驱动的绿色清洗加剧了环境信息披露的不透明性，颠覆了监管监督，而现有法律基于人类意图的责任认定模式无法有效应对算法产生的欺骗性可持续发展声明。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律人类中心主义偏见理论、企业刑事责任理论、算法责任理论、环境法理学
AI.method: 采用法律教义学方法，系统分析司法先例、法律文书和监管指令
AI.findings: 发现现有欺诈和环境法规在面对AI生成的虚假陈述时显得过时；严格责任模式具有可行性；需要重新调整公司治理框架以纳入AI问责制；欧盟CSDDD指令提供了跨国监管协调的潜在模式
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了混合责任框架，将算法风险评估与法律人格建构相结合；推动了AI伦理和环境法理学的话语发展
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了算法尽职调查授权的制度化建议；为企业ESG合规制度提供了实践指导；促进了跨国监管协调的模式发展

title: Low Glycemic Index Rice and Rice-Based Products: Understanding Filipino Consumer Awareness, Knowledge, and Behavior
affiliations: Philippine Rice Research Institute, Philippine Rice Research Institute, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Philippine Rice Research Institute and Philippine Rice Research Institute

detail.title: Low Glycemic Index Rice and Rice-Based Products: Understanding Filipino Consumer Awareness, Knowledge, and Behavior
detail.abstract: The increasing incidence of diabetes and other non-communicable diseases (NCDs) has raised concerns, especially with the population’s high intake of carbohydrates and unhealthy food choices. This study examined Filipino consumers’ awareness, knowledge, and willingness to pay (WTP) for low-GI rice and rice-based products. Data was gathered through an online survey using Google Forms, applying the Cochran sampling technique using a structured questionnaire and convenience sampling captured responses from 328 individuals aged 16–65 across all Philippine regions. Most respondents were female millennials aged 24 to 41, college-educated professionals living in urban areas. Despite being categorized as low-income earners (earning Php 12,030 – 24,060), they were not considered poor. A majority identified as non-diabetic, though findings showed that pre-diabetes was more common in rural areas, while Type 2 diabetes appeared more often in urban settings. Both male and female respondents reported managing their health by making healthier food choices and avoiding sweets. While many were aware of the benefits of low-GI foods, white rice remained the preferred choice. Taste, satiety, nutrition, affordability, and convenience were the top factors considered when buying food. There was a strong interest in trying low-GI products, especially ready-to-drink beverages and native rice cakes. Millennials stood out as a key group open to low-GI options. The study recommends further promoting brown rice, particularly in underserved regions, and conducting face-to-face research to better understand the motivations behind consumer choices.

AI.tldr: 这项研究调查了菲律宾消费者对低生糖指数米米和米制品的认知、知识和支付意愿。结果显示虽然消费者对低GI食品有强烈兴趣，但白米仍是首选。千秋一代是关键目标群体。建议加强粤米推广并进行面对面研究。
AI.research_question: 菲律宾消费者对低生糖指数米米和米制品的认知、知识和支付意愿如何？
AI.motivation: 糖尿病和其他非传染性疾病的发病率不断增加，特别是人们高碳水化合物和不健康食品选择的问题引起关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者行为理论、健康食品选择理论、支付意愿(WTP)理论
AI.method: 通过Google Forms进行在线调查，采用Cochran抽样技术和便利抽样，访问了328名16-65岁的菲律宾各地区居民，使用结构化问卷
AI.findings: 1. 虽然认识低GI食品好处，但白米仍是首选 2. 味道、饱腹感、营养、价格和方便性是购买主要考量因素 3. 千秋一代是低GI产品的关键接受群体 4. 前期糖尿病在农村更常见，2型糖尿病在城市更多发 5. 对即饮饮料和土而米糕有强烈兴趣
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家健康食品消费行为理论，提供了关于低放收入群体对健康食品接受度的新见解
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为低GI米制品市场营销提供精准对象(千秋一代) 2. 建议重点推广粤米特别是在较少服务地区 3. 建议进行面对面研究以更深入了解消费动机

title: The American Empire was Never a Democracy
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: The American Empire was Never a Democracy
detail.abstract: This working paper argues that the United States has historically operated less as a participatory democracy than as a managed republic in which elite interests exercise outsized influence over political, economic, and informational institutions. From the constitutional design-explicitly concerned with protecting the "minority of the opulent"-to contemporary mechanisms of social control, money in politics, militarized foreign policy, and concentrated media ownership, patterns of power persist. Synthesizing scholarship and official data, the paper traces continuities from slavery and the Three-Fifths Compromise to mass incarceration and felony disenfranchisement; from Gilded Age industrial capitalism to modern wealth concentration and extreme CEO-toworker pay gaps; and from Cold War covert action to an extensive global base network and post-9/11 war casualties. The analysis concludes with reforms compatible with a more democratic political economy, including universal social rights, robust voting and representation reforms, workplace democracy, anti-monopoly enforcement, campaign finance reform, and a diplomacy-first grand strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文认为美国历史上更像一个精英管理的共和国而非参与式民主，精英利益通过政治、经济和信息制度施加过度影响。从宪法设计到当代社会控制机制，权力模式持续存在。论文追溯了从奴隶制到大规模监禁、从镀金时代到现代财富集中、从冷战秘密行动到全球军事基地网络的连续性。最后提出了兼容更民主政治经济体系的改革方案。
AI.research_question: 美国是否真正实现了参与式民主，还是本质上是一个精英管理的共和国？
AI.motivation: 探讨美国政治体系中精英利益对民主制度的系统性影响，揭示历史延续的权力不平等模式
AI.theoretical_framework: 精英民主理论、政治经济学、制度分析、历史延续性理论
AI.method: 文献综述和官方数据综合分析，历史比较分析
AI.findings: 美国存在从建国至今持续的权力不平等模式，精英利益通过宪法设计、经济制度、司法系统和外交政策等多个层面维持主导地位
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了美国民主制度的批判性分析框架，揭示了历史延续性的权力结构模式
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一系列民主改革方案，包括普遍社会权利、选举改革、工作场所民主、反垄断执法、竞选财务改革和外交优先战略

title: Market Size Uncertainty, Incomplete Market Research, Dominance of Bertrand Firms Over Cournot Firms
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Market Size Uncertainty, Incomplete Market Research, Dominance of Bertrand Firms Over Cournot Firms
detail.abstract: Between Bertrand and Cournot market duopoly games, it is well known that Cournot firms earn higher profit than Bertrand firms but Bertrand firms produce higher social gains than Cournot firms. We investigate the robustness of this result in the context of a liner demand and constant marginal cost model with demand size uncertainty and incomplete market research. Demand size uncertainty arises as an unknown slope of linear demand, and incomplete market research is introduced since firms' decisions are made under incomplete information about demand. Given this model specification, we show that for any degree of product substitutability (except for the case of homogeneous products), Bertrand firms dominate Cournot firms in expected equilibrium profit, consumer surplus and total surplus when there is a sufficiently high degree of demand size uncertainty. As a result, typical trade-off results between private gains (profit) and social gains do not arise between Bertrand and Cournot games. We show that Cournot firms face a higher price elasticity Bertrand firms when there is a high enough degree of demand size uncertainty. With heightened competitive pressure due to high price elasticity, Cournot firms suffer more revenue loss and thus profit in equilibrium than Bertrand firms. Finally, we show that if demand uncertainty is introduced as a parallel shift of linear demand, then Bertrand firms cannot have their expected equilibrium profit more than Cournot firms, and Cournot firms' expected price elasticity cannot exceed Bertrand firms' expected price elasticity. Remarkably, this result holds for general joint probability distributions which produce an interior equilibrium in both Bertrand and Cournot games in which non-negative price and output constraints do not bind.

AI.tldr: 在需求规模不确定性和不完全市场研究背景下，Bertrand竞争企业在预期均衡利润、消费者剩余和总剩余方面优于Cournot竞争企业，打破了传统认知中Cournot企业利润更高而Bertrand企业社会福利更好的典型权衡关系。
AI.research_question: 在需求规模不确定性和不完全信息条件下，Bertrand和Cournot两种市场竞争模式在利润和社会福利方面的相对表现如何？
AI.motivation: 传统理论认为Cournot企业利润高于Bertrand企业，但Bertrand企业产生更高的社会福利。本研究旨在检验这一结论在需求不确定性和不完全信息条件下的稳健性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于线性需求和不变边际成本模型，引入需求规模不确定性（线性需求斜率未知）和不完全市场研究（企业在不完全需求信息下决策）
AI.method: 理论模型分析，比较Bertrand和Cournot竞争在需求不确定性条件下的均衡结果，包括预期利润、消费者剩余和总剩余
AI.findings: 对于任何程度的产品替代性（除同质产品外），当需求规模不确定性足够高时，Bertrand企业在预期均衡利润、消费者剩余和总剩余方面都优于Cournot企业
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统Bertrand-Cournot权衡理论，揭示了需求不确定性如何改变竞争模式的相对优势，提出了需求不确定性类型（规模vs平行移动）对竞争结果的关键影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业战略选择提供了新见解，在高度不确定的市场环境中，价格竞争可能比产量竞争更有利，为监管政策制定提供了理论依据

title: Analysis of Grain Yield and Yield Contributing Traits in Maize Inbred Lines through Correlation and Path Coefficient Approaches
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Analysis of Grain Yield and Yield Contributing Traits in Maize Inbred Lines through Correlation and Path Coefficient Approaches
detail.abstract: Grain yield in maize is a complex quantitative trait that is highly influenced by environmental conditions and governed by intricate interactions among multiple yield-contributing characters. The complexity arises from both genetic and environmental factors, making direct selection for yield challenging. Hence, analyzing genotypic and phenotypic correlation coefficients among various agronomic traits is essential to elucidate the nature and extent of their association with grain yield. The present study aimed to dissect the relationships among yield contributing traits and identify key determinants of grain yield in maize inbred lines through correlation and path coefficient analysis. A set of 50 diverse maize inbred lines was evaluated during the Rabi, 2024–25, at the Regional Agricultural Research Station, Lam, Guntur, in an Alpha Lattice Design with two replications. Data were recorded on thirteen traits, including days to 50% anthesis, days to 50% silking, anthesis silking interval, days to maturity, plant height, ear height, ear length, ear girth, number of kernel rows per ear, number of kernels per row, 100-kernel weight, SPAD chlorophyll meter readings (SCMR) and grain yield per plant. Genotypic and phenotypic correlation analysis revealed significant positive associations of days to maturity, plant height, ear height, ear length, ear girth, number of kernel rows per ear, number of kernels per row, 100-kernel weight and SPAD Chlorophyll Meter Reading (SCMR) with grain yield per plant, indicating their potential utility for indirect selection. Path coefficient analysis indicated that anthesis-silking interval, plant height, 100-kernel weight and SPAD Chlorophyll Meter Reading (SCMR) exhibited positive direct effects on grain yield per plant at both genotypic and phenotypic levels, highlighting their importance in breeding programs. These findings provide critical insights for maize breeders to enhance grain yield through the strategic selection of key traits.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过相关性和通径系数分析，揭示了玉米自交系中产量构成性状之间的关系，发现成熟天数、株高、穗位高、穗长、穗粗、每穗行数、每行粒数、百粒重和SPAD叶绿素读数与籽粒产量呈显著正相关，其中开花-吐丝间隔、株高、百粒重和SPAD叶绿素读数对产量具有直接正向影响。
AI.research_question: 玉米自交系中产量构成性状之间的关系是什么？哪些是关键决定籽粒产量的性状？
AI.motivation: 玉米产量是一个复杂的数量性状，受环境条件影响大且由多个产量构成性状的复杂互作调控，直接选择产量具有挑战性，需要分析性状间的基因型和表型相关性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数量遗传学、相关分析理论、通径系数分析理论
AI.method: 采用Alpha格子设计，在2024-25年Rabi季节评估50个玉米自交系，记录13个农艺性状数据，进行基因型和表型相关分析以及通径系数分析。
AI.findings: 成熟天数、株高、穗位高、穗长、穗粗、每穗行数、每行粒数、百粒重和SPAD叶绿素读数与籽粒产量呈显著正相关；开花-吐丝间隔、株高、百粒重和SPAD叶绿素读数在基因型和表型水平上对产量具有直接正向影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 阐明了玉米产量构成性状间的复杂关系网络，验证了通径系数分析在解析性状直接和间接效应中的有效性，为数量性状遗传研究提供了方法论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为玉米育种者提供了关键性状选择策略，可通过间接选择开花-吐丝间隔、株高、百粒重和SPAD叶绿素读数等性状来提高籽粒产量，提升育种效率。

declarations.funderStatement: Greer Burns and Crain partially funded the research through a research gift to the Center for Anti-Counterfeiting and Product Protection.

detail.abstract: This Article analyzes the emergence and evolution of Schedule A litigation as a procedural mechanism for combating online trademark counterfeiting. In response to the proliferation of anonymous infringers operating through third-party e-commerce platforms, plaintiffs have increasingly relied on expedited judicial remedies—including ex parte temporary restraining orders, asset freezes, and electronic service—to enforce intellectual property rights. The authors examine the doctrinal foundations of these cases, focusing on joinder under Rule 20, personal jurisdiction over foreign defendants, and the equitable basis for broad injunctive relief. Drawing on historical interpretations of the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure and recent district court decisions, the Article argues that Schedule A litigation represents a legitimate and scalable adaptation of existing procedural tools to meet the challenges posed by law-disruptive technologies. It further considers the implications of this litigation model for due process, judicial economy, and the future of transnational IP enforcement.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了Schedule A诉讼作为打击在线商标侵权程序机制的出现和演变，探讨了其法理基础、程序工具适应性以及对正当程序和国际知识产权执法的意义。
AI.research_question: Schedule A诉讼如何作为程序机制应对在线商标侵权问题？其法理基础和实践效果如何？
AI.motivation: 随着匿名侵权者通过第三方电商平台大量涌现，原告需要依赖快速司法救济来执行知识产权，因此催生了Schedule A诉讼的发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于联邦民事诉讼规则的历史解释，特别是Rule 20下的共同诉讼规则、对外国被告的个人管辖权理论，以及衡平法下广泛禁令救济的法理基础。
AI.method: 通过分析历史判例和近期地区法院判决，进行法理分析和案例研究。

detail.title: Foreign Institutional Investors and Natural Disaster Shocks
detail.abstract: The latest Global Assessment Report from the United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR, 2025) highlights the rapid acceleration of climate change and the increasing frequency of natural disasters worldwide. This paper examines the role of foreign institutional investors in mitigating the impact of country-specific natural disasters and climate risks on corporate investment. It analyzes natural disasters across 46 countries as localized exogenous shocks to explore how foreign institutional investors could potentially act as a stabilizing force in these situations. The empirical findings show that among firms affected by natural disasters, those with high foreign institutional ownership are more resilient in maintaining corporate investment. These results remain robust to numerous subsamples and types of natural disasters. While natural disasters can cause significant damage to the global economy, the findings of this study demonstrate that governments have the opportunity to develop better policies and institutional frameworks to enhance their country's resilience to natural disaster shocks, especially in developing countries, which may also help attract sustainable foreign capital inflows.

detail.title: Climate Anxiety among South Asian Youth: Psychological Impacts, Coping Mechanisms, and Policy Implications
detail.abstract: Climate change is increasingly recognized as both an environmental and psychological challenge. In South Asia, and especially in Bangladesh, young people are among the most vulnerable to its impacts. Recurring floods, river erosion, displacement, and livelihood insecurity have contributed to rising levels of climate-related anxiety, hopelessness, and ecological grief. This paper examines climate anxiety among South Asian youth using ecological systems theory, resilience theory, and eco-psychology as guiding frameworks. Drawing on recent studies and international evidence, it highlights the psychological symptoms most often reported, including persistent worry, loss of agency, and depression. The discussion emphasizes regional vulnerabilities such as poverty, gender disparities, and limited access to mental health care. It also considers the role of education, media, and policy responses in shaping young people's experiences of climate distress. Examples of school programs, community resilience efforts, and emerging policy initiatives are reviewed to identify promising strategies of support. The paper concludes with research gaps and recommendations for culturally sensitive, long-term interventions. Addressing climate anxiety among South Asian youth is presented as both a mental health priority and a critical component of sustainable development.

detail.abstract: This working paper explores the story of a so-called "party switch" in U.S. politics and argues that although partisan coalitions have changed, systemic power structuressuch as money in politics, racialized social control, national security expansion, and concentrated corporate influence-have stayed largely the same. By combining historical accounts, legal milestones, and current critiques, the paper follows the timeline from Reconstruction to today: the 13th Amendment's punishment clause and prison labor; patterns of voter suppression from Jim Crow to now; the Civil Rights era's partial shifts; waves of punitive policies in the 1990s; and the post-9/11 increase in surveillance and executive power. It also places these domestic issues within a foreign policy that mixes moral language with realpolitik. The analysis argues that the U.S. functions as a lasting duopoly that manages popular consent while shifting partisan branding. The conclusion proposes reforms that support a more democratic political economy, including universal social rights, stronger voting and representation laws, anti-monopoly measures, campaign finance reform, and a diplomacy-first grand strategy.

detail.title: The Value of Commitment in a Network Evidence Game
detail.abstract: We consider an evidence game in which a principal seeks to award a high-quality agent. Agents, competing for the award, may hold evidence about their own and peers' qualities (i.i.d. good or bad) as determined by a network. They can conceal or disclose each piece of evidence to the principal. Baumann and Dutta (forthcoming) analyze the robust sequential equilibria where the principal has no commitment power and moves last. We show that when the principal can commit to a mechanism, she can improve over her most preferred robust sequential equilibrium but she cannot achieve her first-best outcome.

detail.abstract: Medieval Templar commanderies accepted deposits and issued sealed receipts redeemable across Europe and the Levant. Historians usually treat these instruments as representative money or early cheques. This paper reframes two elements: first, the Templar financial network is analysed as a permissioned, federated settlement architecture that relocated trust from a single sovereign to shared institutional rules, and second, the sealed receipts are interpreted as a network-native bearer instrument, a proto-cryptocurrency constrained by recorded deposits and recognised across nodes. The analysis maps operations to core blockchain ideas of purpose, consensus, incentives, token rules, and network effects, and it states the limits clearly: seals authenticated issuers rather than bearers, audits replaced algorithmic consensus, access was permissioned, and scarcity was deposit-backed rather than protocol-defined. The claim is architectural, not technological. Templar receipts solved the same portability problem that blockchains address, using institutional tools rather than code, which situates cryptocurrencies within a longer history of organising trust and value across distance.

title: Sanctions, Security, and the WTO: Navigating Article XXI in the Russia-Ukraine Conflict
affiliations: Gujarat National Law University and Gujarat National Law University

detail.title: Sanctions, Security, and the WTO: Navigating Article XXI in the Russia-Ukraine Conflict
detail.abstract:
Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, provoked the most sweeping package of economic sanctions in modern history, testing the boundaries of the World Trade Organization (WTO) framework and its capacity to govern trade amid geopolitical conflict. More than forty countries, including the United States, European Union, and Japan, adopted coordinated restrictions across goods, services, finance, and intellectual property, while Russia retaliated with countersanctions such as zero-remuneration patent licensing and legalization of parallel imports. These measures raise profound questions about the scope and justiciability of national security exceptions under WTO law, particularly GATT Article XXI, GATS Article XIV bis, and TRIPS Article 73.

This paper situates current sanctions within the doctrinal trajectory set by Russia—Traffic in Transit (DS512) and the 2022 Section 232 panels, which clarified that Article XXI is reviewable subject to good-faith and plausibility standards. It provides a typology of sanctions and countersanctions, analyzing their engagement with WTO obligations across goods (import bans, MFN suspension, export controls), services and finance (SWIFT exclusion, transport and insurance bans), and intellectual property (Decree 299, parallel imports). The analysis demonstrates that while the Russia-Ukraine conflict constitutes a clear “emergency in international relations,” Members must still substantiate the nexus between measures and essential security interests.

Beyond doctrine, the paper highlights systemic risks of exception creep and trade fragmentation, as national security claims increasingly overlap with industrial policy and bloc-based “friend-shoring.” To safeguard the multilateral system, it advances normative proposals: enhanced notification and transparency requirements, time-bound security measures with humanitarian carve-outs, clearer delineation of prudential versus security justifications under GATS, guardrails on TRIPS compulsory licensing, and use of DSU Article 25 arbitration as an interim appellate mechanism.

The study concludes that WTO law must balance deference to genuine security imperatives with procedural safeguards to prevent abuse. Properly disciplined, Article XXI can accommodate emergency responses while preserving the integrity of a rules-based trading system in an era of geopolitical rivalry.

detail.abstract: We analyze the interaction between self-insurance and market insurance when accident losses are multivalued. This contrasts sharply with the conclusion of Ehrlich and Becker (1972) who establish the substitutability between self-insurance and market insurance when the cost of an accident is single-valued.

detail.abstract: In this paper, we provide a unique ensemble-based framework that combines sophisticated deep learning architectures and novel ensemble algorithms to improve forecast accuracy and robustness. The framework includes the Stacking Ensemble Meta-Model, which aggregates predictions as meta-features that are processed by a linear regression meta-model. We also introduce an Optimized Weighted Ensemble model, which uses constrained optimization to compute optimal weights for combining predictions from LSTM, CNN, and Hybrid CNN/LSTM-Attention-based models. Our results show that our proposed ensemble meta-model framework outperforms the optimized weighted ensemble model, with improved predictive accuracy across the evaluation metrices.

affiliations: Suresh Gyan Vihar University

detail.title: A Study of the Selected Product Categories in India: The Influence of Virtual Influencers on Consumer Behavior
detail.abstract:
The rapid advancement of digital marketing has resulted in the emergence of Virtual Influencers (VIs), which are computer-generated characters that are intended to captivate audiences on social media platforms. In contrast to conventional influencers, VIs are equipped with AI and 3D design technologies, which provide brands with complete control over their identity and messaging. Kyra and other virtual influencers are acquiring popularity in India, collaborating with brands such as Puma, Maybelline, and Amazon Fashion. 

The fashion and beauty industries, which are characterized by aspirational lifestyles and aesthetics, are ideal environments for virtual influencer marketing. Nevertheless, it is still uncertain whether consumers in India regard VIs as credible, authentic, and trustworthy enough to affect their purchasing decisions. The objective of this investigation is to evaluate the efficacy of virtual influencers in comparison to conventional influencers and investigate their influence on consumer behavior.

AI.motivation: 数字营销快速发展催生了虚拟影响者，这些AI和3D技术生成的角色在时尚美妆行业获得品牌合作，但其在印度消费者中的影响力尚不明确。

title: Spillover Effects of Retail Labor Disruptions
affiliations: Tilburg University and Emory University - Information Systems and Operations Management

detail.title: Spillover Effects of Retail Labor Disruptions

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: Grocery stores provide an essential and highly competitive offering involving a variety of suppliers and serving heterogeneous communities. We use this context to examine the unintended spillover effects of labor strikes on a firm's upstream and downstream constituents, determining whether such disruptions disproportionately burden disadvantaged participants, including regional and niche suppliers, as well as low-income consumers. Our analysis applies moderated difference-indifferences regression models against detailed retail transaction data to isolate the impact on different supplier and customer classes that are serving or served by striking stores during the strike period. We provide evidence that regional and niche suppliers experience significantly larger sales losses than their national and mass-market counterparts, and consumers in low-income communities face larger increases in paid prices compared to consumers in high-income communities. We extend our analysis to provide empirical support that firms practicing less discounting have lower negative spillover effects on their suppliers, and firms with focused operations have lower negative spillovers on low-income communities. For firms committed to responsible retailing, our research raises awareness that labor disruptions affect the firm's upstream suppliers and downstream customers, particularly the most exposed among them. Our findings on the benefits of restricted discounting and focused operations raise the prospect that firms may reduce inequitable burdens and uphold their social responsibility objectives with other tailored mitigation strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，超市劳工罢工对上游供应商和下游消费者产生不均衡的负面影响，区域和小众供应商比全国性供应商遭受更大销售损失，低收入社区消费者面临更高价格涨幅。限制折扣和专注运营的企业能减轻这些不平等影响。
AI.research_question: 劳工罢工对企业的上游供应商和下游消费者会产生怎样的溢出效应？这些影响是否不成比例地加重了弱势参与者（区域和小众供应商、低收入消费者）的负担？
AI.motivation: 超市行业竞争激烈，涉及多种供应商和服务不同社区。劳工罢工可能对企业的利益相关者产生意想不到的连锁影响，特别是可能对弱势群体造成不成比例的负担，这关系到企业的社会责任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于供应链管理理论、企业社会责任理论和利益相关者理论，探讨劳工罢工对上下游参与者的溢出效应及其不平等分布。
AI.method: 采用调节双重差分回归模型，分析详细的零售交易数据，分离罢工期间不同供应商类别和消费者群体受到的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 区域和小众供应商比全国性和大众市场供应商遭受显著更大的销售损失；2) 低收入社区消费者比高收入社区消费者面临更大的价格上涨；3) 较少折扣的企业对供应商的负面溢出效应较低；4) 运营专注的企业对低收入社区的负面溢出效应较低。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了劳工罢工影响的研究视角，从传统的企业层面扩展到上下游利益相关者，揭示了溢出效应的不平等分布机制，丰富了企业社会责任理论在供应链情境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了减轻罢工负面影响的具体策略：限制折扣和专注运营可以减少不平等负担。研究提醒负责任零售企业关注劳工 disruptions 对最脆弱利益相关者的影响，并可通过定制化缓解策略来履行社会责任目标。

title: The Influence of Hunger-marketing Strategy on Consumer Refund Intention in Live E-commerce: Considering the Moderating Effect of Similar Product Comparison
affiliations: Osaka University, Shanghai University, Shanghai University and The University of Osaka

detail.title: The Influence of Hunger-marketing Strategy on Consumer Refund Intention in Live E-commerce: Considering the Moderating Effect of Similar Product Comparison

keywords.keywords: Refund intention · Perceived deception · Emotional dissonance · Live e-commerce · Hunger-marketing

detail.abstract: Hunger-marketing is a double-edged sword as it can boost sales, but also lead to refunds. Owing to the significant differences in marketing techniques between live and traditional e-commerce, the refund mechanism resulting from hunger-marketing in the former needs to be explored. This study employs the cognitive dissonance theory and S-O-R model to explore how hunger-marketing stimuli (time pressure and resonant contagion) induce regret (emotional dissonance and perceived deception), generating refund intentions among consumers. This study also examines the moderating effect of similar product comparisons on the relationship between hunger-marketing and regret. The results find: (1) Hunger-marketing positively affects emotional dissonance and perceived deception; perceived deception directly positively affects refund intentions, while emotional dissonance indirectly affects refund intentions through perceived deception. (2) The similar-product comparison positively moderates the impact of time pressure on emotional dissonance and resonant contagion on perceived deception; therefore, displaying similar products should be avoided.

AI.tldr: 饥饿营销在直播电商中是一把双刃剑，能促进销售但也会导致退款。研究发现时间压力和共鸣传染会引发情感失调和感知欺骗，进而产生退款意愿，类似产品比较会加剧这种负面效应。
AI.research_question: 直播电商中的饥饿营销如何通过引发消费者的后悔情绪（情感失调和感知欺骗）来产生退款意愿？
AI.motivation: 直播电商与传统电商在营销技术上存在显著差异，需要探索饥饿营销在直播电商中引发的退款机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知失调理论和S-O-R模型（刺激-有机体-反应模型）
AI.method: 实证研究方法，通过调查问卷收集数据，分析饥饿营销刺激对消费者情绪和退款意愿的影响
AI.findings: 1) 饥饿营销正向影响情感失调和感知欺骗；感知欺骗直接正向影响退款意愿，情感失调通过感知欺骗间接影响退款意愿；2) 类似产品比较正向调节时间压力对情感失调的影响，以及共鸣传染对感知欺骗的影响
AI.theory_contributions: 将认知失调理论和S-O-R模型应用于直播电商饥饿营销研究，揭示了退款行为的内在心理机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为直播电商平台提供管理启示：应避免展示类似产品，以减少饥饿营销引发的负面情绪和退款行为

title: User Perceptions of RBI-Approved P2P Digital Lending Apps: An NLP and Machine, Deep Learning Approach
affiliations: VIT-AP University and VIT-AP University

detail.title: User Perceptions of RBI-Approved P2P Digital Lending Apps: An NLP and Machine, Deep Learning Approach
detail.abstract: Digital lending, often known as alternative lending, refers to fintech platforms that offer quick and easy loans via digital channels, bypassing many of the limits of traditional banking. Digital lending has become a prominent Fintech innovation since the mid-2000s, with rapid growth in India due to financial inclusion measures, but it continues to face difficulties such as fraud, transparency, and consumer unhappiness. This study's main objective was to find out how consumers see and assess Indi’s RBI approved P2P Digital lending apps by mining massive amount of customer feedback to identify strength, shortcomings, and overall satisfaction levels. Research used web scraping to obtain 15408 Google play store reviews from 7 lending platforms 5Pais, Faircent, i2iFunding, LenDenClub, CahKumar, Lendbox, and India Money Mart. The reviews were preprocessed with text cleaning, tokenization, and sentiment tagging before being examined with NLP, machine learning, and deep learning techniques. Topic modeling revealed 11 recurring topics, Sentiment analysis revealed that 55% of evaluations were good, 41% were negative, and 4% were neutral, with strengths in loan disbursement, withdrawals, and EMI payments, but flaws in interface design, rejection transparency, and login functioning. Comparative data showed that India Money Mart and i2iFunding had the highest user perception, while 5Paisa and Lendbox trailed owing to continuous complaints regarding transparency, accessibility, and user experience. In terms of modeling, the deep learning model VGG16 and ensemble machine learning techniques (XGBoost, CatBoost, and LightGBM) consistently produced the best predicted accuracy (up to 0.88), surpassing more straightforward models like Decision Tree or ResNet. Overall, the results show how digital lending can promote financial inclusion, but they also emphasize how better user interface/user experience (UI/UX), rejection transparency, and customer service are necessary to build confidence and encourage long-term adoption.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析印度7个P2P数字借贷平台的15,408条用户评论，使用NLP和机器学习技术发现55%评论为正面，主要优势在贷款发放和支付功能，但存在界面设计和透明度问题。深度学习模型VGG16和集成学习方法表现最佳，准确率达0.88。

AI.motivation: 数字借贷作为金融科技的重要创新，在印度快速发展但面临欺诈、透明度和消费者不满等挑战，需要通过用户反馈分析来了解真实用户体验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于用户满意度理论、金融科技采纳理论和文本挖掘理论，结合自然语言处理和机器学习方法分析用户反馈。
AI.method: 通过网络爬虫获取7个借贷平台的15,408条Google Play商店评论，进行文本清洗、分词和情感标注，使用NLP、机器学习和深度学习技术（包括主题建模、情感分析和预测建模）进行分析。
AI.findings: 1) 主题建模识别出11个重复主题；2) 情感分析显示55%正面、41%负面、4%中性评价；3) 优势：贷款发放、取款和EMI支付；4) 缺陷：界面设计、拒绝透明度和登录功能；5) India Money Mart和i2iFunding用户感知最佳，5Paisa和Lendbox最差；6) VGG16和集成学习方法预测准确率最高达0.88。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了数字借贷平台用户评价分析的理论框架；2) 验证了深度学习在金融科技用户反馈分析中的有效性；3) 揭示了印度数字借贷市场的用户满意度驱动因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为数字借贷平台提供了改进UI/UX、增强透明度和客户服务的具体方向；2) 为监管机构提供了用户痛点的实证证据；3) 为消费者选择借贷平台提供了参考依据；4) 促进了数字借贷的长期采纳和信任建立。

title: Marriage as collateral (damage)? Gender and Family Status in P2P Loan Auctions
affiliations: Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts and Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts

detail.title: Marriage as collateral (damage)? Gender and Family Status in P2P Loan Auctions
detail.abstract: This paper examines how retail investors assess and price credit risk in an online peer-to-peer (P2P) consumer lending market that operates through a reverse auction mechanism and under conditions of imperfect information. Drawing on a unique dataset of 665 Swiss P2P loans, we analyze how loan-specific, borrower-specific, and macroeconomic variables influence interest rate setting in a decentralized, pre-algorithmic market environment. Our findings suggest that investors generally respond systematically to observable indicators of credit risk - such as loan maturity, debt-to-income ratios, and macroeconomic conditions. However, we also uncover patterns indicative of biases: while no significant gender gap in loan rates is observed overall, unmarried women with children are charged significantly higher interest rates, suggesting that perceived socioeconomic vulnerability may influence risk assessments. These results are novel in that they interact gender with family status and highlight the dual nature of investor behavior — both economically rational and behaviorally influenced — while underscoring the continued relevance of platform design and borrower visibility for ensuring fair and efficient credit allocation. By offering a rare empirical window into the early stages of P2P lending, this study provides a foundational perspective for understanding investor decision-making in digital credit markets.

title: Fintech Financial Accelerator: Evidence from a Social Media Field Experiment in China *

detail.title: Fintech Financial Accelerator: Evidence from a Social Media Field Experiment in China *
detail.abstract: We conduct a field experiment in China, offering small business owners a conditional social media advertising subsidy. Beyond boosting business revenue and employment, the intervention significantly increases access to fintech credit: treated firms are more likely to open online stores and obtain online loans, while bank credit remains unaffected. Our findings reveal a "fintech accelerator" mechanism-digital marketing drives sales growth that directly improves firms' eligibility for fintech lending-demonstrating how targeted digital interventions can enhance financial inclusion and reshape credit allocation for small businesses.

title: Access to Emergency Contraceptive Pills (Plan B) and Underage Drinking
affiliations: Virginia Tech, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Southern Illinois University - Southern Illinois University at Edwardsville

detail.title: Access to Emergency Contraceptive Pills (Plan B) and Underage Drinking
detail.abstract: This study examines the unintended impact of expanded access to emergency contraceptive pills (ECPs) on the alcohol-related behavior of female adolescents.  Within a triple-difference design, we exploit the 2006 U.S. Food and Drug Administration policy that allowed individuals 18 and older to purchase ECPs over-the-counter, considering that females are disproportionately affected by unplanned pregnancy. We find that the policy is linked to an increase in alcohol-related arrests and admissions to treatment facilities, as well as a rise in alcohol use among high schoolers. This suggests that the lower perceived risk of unplanned pregnancy may encourage risky behavior in other related domains.

title: Beyond Softmax: A New Perspective on Gradient Bandits
affiliations: Indiana University Bloomington and Techniche Universitat Chemnitz

detail.title: Beyond Softmax: A New Perspective on Gradient Bandits
detail.abstract: We establish a link between a class of discrete choice models and the theory of online learning and multi-armed bandits. Our contributions are: (i) sublinear regret bounds for a broad algorithmic family, encompassing Exp3 as a special case; (ii) a new class of adversarial bandit algorithms derived from generalized nested logit models [Wen and Koppelman, 2001]; and (iii) we introduce a novel class of generalized gradient bandit algorithms that extends beyond the widely used softmax formulation. By relaxing the restrictive independence assumptions inherent in softmax, our framework accommodates correlated learning dynamics across actions, thereby broadening the applicability of gradient bandit methods. Overall, the proposed algorithms combine flexible model specification with computational efficiency via closed-form sampling probabilities. Numerical experiments in stochastic bandit settings demonstrate their practical effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 该论文建立了离散选择模型与在线学习/多臂老虎机理论的联系，提出了具有次线性遗憾界的算法家族，从广义嵌套logit模型推导出新算法，并引入了超越softmax的广义梯度老虎机算法。
AI.research_question: 如何建立离散选择模型与在线学习理论的联系，并开发出能够处理相关学习动态的新型老虎机算法？
AI.motivation: 传统softmax算法存在独立性假设限制，无法处理动作间的相关学习动态，需要开发更灵活的算法框架。

title: Explaining the Unexplainable: A Systematic Review of Explainable AI in Finance
affiliations: University of Tulsa and University of Dhaka

detail.title: Explaining the Unexplainable: A Systematic Review of Explainable AI in Finance
detail.abstract: Practitioners and researchers trying to strike a balance between accuracy and transparency center Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) at the junction of finance. This paper offers a thorough overview of the changing scene of XAI applications in finance together with domain-specific implementations, methodological developments, and trend mapping of research. Using bibliometric and content analysis, we find topic clusters, significant research, and most often used explainability strategies used in financial industries. Our results show a substantial dependence on post-hoc interpretability techniques; attention mechanisms, feature importance analysis and SHAP are the most often used techniques among them. This review stresses the need of multidisciplinary approaches combining financial knowledge with improved explainability paradigms and exposes important shortcomings in present XAI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献计量和内容分析，系统回顾了可解释人工智能（XAI）在金融领域的应用现状、方法发展和研究趋势，发现当前主要依赖事后可解释性技术，并强调需要将金融专业知识与改进的可解释性范式相结合的多学科方法。

title: Unauthorized Immigrants and Cash Holdings
affiliations: University of North Dakota - Department of Economics and Finance

detail.title: Unauthorized Immigrants and Cash Holdings
detail.abstract: I examine how legal restrictions on hiring unauthorized immigrants affect corporate cash holdings by exploiting the staggered adoption of state-level E-Verify laws that require employers to use federal databases to verify workers' eligibility. Following the adoption of the laws, firms in affected states significantly increase cash holdings, particularly those with greater reliance on unauthorized immigrant labor, higher cash flow volatility, greater operating leverage, financial constraints, lower unionization, and higher minimum wages. Additional evidence shows that cash flows and profitability decline after the law adoption. Overall, my findings suggest that hiring frictions involving unauthorized immigrants raise financial distress risk and induce more conservative financial policies.

detail.abstract: Republic Act No. 11223, the Universal Health Care Act of the Philippines, was enacted in 2019 to ensure equitable access to quality health services for all Filipinos. This case study critically analyzes the Act's progress, strengths, and persistent challenges. While RA 11223 represents a significant advancement towards universal health coverage by expanding access to primary care and integrating citizens into the National Health Insurance Program, its implementation faces obstacles. These include sustainable funding mechanisms, inadequate health infrastructure, and workforce capacity shortages, particularly in rural areas. The Act has the potential to reduce health disparities and improve economic productivity by lowering out-of-pocket health expenditures. However, realizing these benefits requires addressing systemic barriers and exploring alternative funding sources. This study recommends strengthening primary care, increasing investment in health infrastructure and human resources, and ensuring efficient resource allocation. Sustained political commitment and collaborative partnerships are crucial for the successful implementation of RA 11223 and the achievement of a healthier and more equitable society.

title: The Impact of High-Speed Rail on Healthy Aging: Empirical Evidence from China
affiliations: Zhongnan University of Economics and Law and Zhongnan University of Economics and Law

detail.title: The Impact of High-Speed Rail on Healthy Aging: Empirical Evidence from China
detail.abstract: Under the ongoing global trend of population ageing, promoting healthy ageing has become a critical issue requiring urgent attention. This study takes China—a typical country experiencing rapid population ageing—as an example and examines how HSR fosters healthy ageing from the perspective of personal health investment. By integrating multiple macro-level and micro-level datasets and leveraging temporal variations in the rollout of HSR across cities, we construct a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) model to empirically assess the impact of HSR on healthy ageing. Our finding reveals that HSR significantly enhances health investment among middle-aged and older adults by expanding market availability of health products. This effect is more pronounced among the elderly, individuals with higher education levels, those in poorer health, and urban residents. Further analysis demonstrates that increased health investment driven by HSR not only improves individual health outcomes and reduces medical expenditures but also exhibits high cost-effectiveness in curbing healthcare costs. Therefore, improving transportation infrastructure networks, particularly HSR systems, can serve as a critical pathway to facilitate personal health investment and thereby advance the process of healthy aging. This offers valuable policy insights for other nations confronting the challenges of population aging.

title: Continuous Learning Pipelines for Perception Models Using Roadside and Fleet-Collected Sensor Fusion Data
affiliations: LADOKE AKINTOLA UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY OGBOMOSO, NIGERIA

detail.title: Continuous Learning Pipelines for Perception Models Using Roadside and Fleet-Collected Sensor Fusion Data
detail.abstract: The advancement of autonomous vehicles (AVs) hinges on the reliability and robustness of their perception systems. While static, deep learning models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities, they are inherently limited by their inability to adapt to the unpredictable and dynamic nature of the real world. This report presents a comprehensive analysis of a transformative approach: a continuous learning pipeline that addresses these limitations by leveraging the complementary strengths of roadside and fleet-collected sensor fusion data. The framework integrates two distinct but synergistic data streams: fine-grained, on-board sensor data from vehicle fleets and wide-ranging, bird's-eye-view data from strategically deployed roadside infrastructure. By synthesizing foundational principles of multi-modal fusion, the architectural components of a closed-loop data pipeline, and the unique advantages and challenges of each data source, a holistic model is proposed. This unified system can autonomously identify, curate, and utilize high-value data-especially from rare, "long-tail" scenarios-to retrain and continuously improve perception models. The report concludes that this integrated approach has the potential to overcome critical safety and performance bottlenecks, paving the way for the scalable and safe deployment of high-level autonomous driving.

title: Beyond the Liquidity Trap: How Digital Divisibility Invalidates Keynes's Core Premise on Deflation

detail.title: Beyond the Liquidity Trap: How Digital Divisibility Invalidates Keynes's Core Premise on Deflation
detail.abstract: This paper presents a fundamental challenge to a core Keynesian doctrine: the axiomatic fear of deflation as a precursor to liquidity traps and economic collapse. We argue that this "deflation fallacy" is a technological anachronism, rooted in the physical limitations of tangible money (e.g., precious metals, paper currency), where deflation indeed led to a crippling scarcity of transactional media. However, the advent of infinitely divisible digital currency severs this link. In such a system, deflation (currency appreciation) manifests not as a reduction in transactional capacity, but merely as a neutral numerical scaling issue on the user interface. Consequently, the theoretical foundation for Keynesian interventionist policies—specifically, inflationary monetary expansion to combat perceived liquidity shortages—is permanently invalidated. This paper further introduces algorithmic denomination change (e.g., version iteration) as a depoliticized, rule-based solution to the user-experience (UX) friction caused by minute transaction units, redefining it not as economic policy but as a front-end optimization. The implications of this paradigm shift are profound and extend to the international arena. It dismantles the rationale for central banks' role as lenders of last resort and discretionary managers of the economy. Moreover, it removes the foundational justification for the current hegemonic, sovereign debt-based international monetary system (e.g., the Triffin Dilemma), paving the way for a new, rules-based order built around apolitical, supranational currency frameworks. This paper concludes that the technological obsolescence of deflation fear necessitates a wholesale reimagining of monetary theory, policy, and the architecture of the global financial system.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了凯恩斯主义对通缩的核心恐惧，认为在数字货币时代通缩不再是流动性陷阱的前兆，而只是用户界面上的数值缩放问题，从而否定了凯恩斯干预政策的理论基础。

AI.motivation: 传统凯恩斯主义对通缩的恐惧基于实物货币时代的物理限制，而数字货币的无限可分性使这种恐惧成为技术过时的产物，需要重新审视货币理论和政策。

AI.method: 理论分析、逻辑推理、技术特征对比分析
AI.findings: 数字货币的无限可分性使通缩仅表现为用户界面数值缩放问题，而非流动性短缺；算法面额调整可解决交易单位过小问题；传统央行干预政策和国际货币体系的理论基础被颠覆。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"通缩谬误"概念，建立数字货币时代的新货币理论框架，挑战凯恩斯主义核心教条，为去政治化货币体系提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字货币设计提供算法面额调整方案，为央行职能重构提供理论依据，为国际货币体系改革指明方向，推动规则化、超主权的全球金融新架构。

title: A Latent Indicator of Regional Greenhouse Gas Emissions from Ukraine’s Energy Sector: Insights from a MIMIC Model
affiliations: Silesian University of Technology, Silesian University of Technology, University of St Gallen and Sumy State University

detail.title: A Latent Indicator of Regional Greenhouse Gas Emissions from Ukraine’s Energy Sector: Insights from a MIMIC Model
detail.abstract: Understanding regional disparities in environmental burden from air emissions is critical in post-industrial economies undergoing energy transitions. This study estimates latent environmental burden from Ukraine's energy sector air emissions using a Multiple Indicators and Multiple Causes (MIMIC) model. Based on a panel dataset of 102 region-year observations (2017-2020), the model integrates observable indicators (e.g. TPP/HPP capacity, electricity output) and structural causes (e.g. gross regional product, thermal electricity production) to capture unobservable emission intensity. To improve model reliability, variables underwent Box-Cox transformation, standardisation, and multicollinearity assessment using Variance Inflation Factors before estimation in R. The refined MIMIC model demonstrates good fit (CFI = 0.956; TLI = 0.920; SRMR = 0.036) and confirms substantial predictive value of thermal electricity output (β = 1.396), heat production (β = 0.294), and an adverse effect of economic output (β = -0.953) on air emission intensity. Indicator loadings are statistically significant, with electricity production achieving the highest standardised loading (0.976). Results reveal persistent high-emission burdens in Donetsk, Dnipropetrovsk, Zaporizhzhya, and Ivano-Frankivsk, with Donetsk reaching the normalised maximum (1.0) in 2018. This framework provides a replicable approach for monitoring unreported pollution dynamics and informing targeted decarbonisation policies in Ukraine’s most affected regions.

AI.method: 使用102个地区-年份观测值（2017-2020）的面板数据集，采用Box-Cox变换、标准化和方差膨胀因子进行多重共线性评估，在R中估计MIMIC模型。

title: Hey, ChatGPT, Can You Set My Prices? Potential Risks of Algorithmic Collusion by Large Language Models
affiliations: Berkeley Research Group, LLC

detail.title: Hey, ChatGPT, Can You Set My Prices? Potential Risks of Algorithmic Collusion by Large Language Models
detail.abstract:
The potential for algorithmic collusion where pricing algorithms learn to tacitly coordinate and raise prices has been a growing concern for antitrust practitioners.  Over the past several years there have been multiple civil antitrust complaints against algorithmic pricing providers and their users. US lawmakers also have proposed legislation aimed at preventing the use of pricing algorithms by companies to fix prices.

While many studies have examined more traditional algorithms, the rapid rise of sophisticated Large Language Models (LLMs), the technology behind tools like ChatGPT, presents a new frontier. A recent research study directly tackles a fascinating question: could LLMs used for automated pricing autonomously learn to collude or otherwise set supracompetitive prices?  In this short article, I discuss and comment on this latest research on LLMs as a pricing agent.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论大型语言模型（LLMs）作为定价代理时可能产生的算法合谋风险，这是反垄断领域的新兴关注点。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型作为定价代理是否能够自主学会合谋或设定超竞争价格？
AI.motivation: 随着定价算法导致隐性协调和价格上涨的算法合谋风险日益增长，以及LLMs技术的快速发展，需要研究这种新型算法在定价中的潜在反竞争行为。

title: What Determines the Out-of-Home Placement of Children in the USA?
affiliations: University of Southampton and University of Reading - ICMA Centre

detail.title: What Determines the Out-of-Home Placement of Children in the USA?
detail.abstract:
Using NCANDS data of US child maltreatment reports for 2009, logistic regression, probit
analysis, discriminant analysis and an artificial neural network are used to determine the
factors which explain the decision to place a child in out-of-home care. As well as developing
a new model for 2009, a previous study using 2005 data is replicated. While there are many
small differences, the four estimation techniques give broadly the same results, demonstrating
the robustness of the results. Similarly, apart from age and sexual abuse, the 2005 and 2009
results are roughly similar. For 2009, child characteristics (particularly child emotional
problems) are more important than the nature of the abuse and the situation of the household;
while caregiver characteristics are the least important. All these models have low explanatory
power.

AI.tldr: 使用多种统计方法分析2009年美国儿童虐待报告数据，发现儿童情感问题是决定是否将儿童安置在家庭外照料的最重要因素，但所有模型解释力都较低。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素解释了将儿童安置在家庭外照料的决定？
AI.motivation: 研究儿童保护服务中安置决策的影响因素，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 儿童保护服务决策理论，安置决策影响因素理论框架
AI.method: 使用NCANDS 2009年数据，采用逻辑回归、probit分析、判别分析和人工神经网络四种统计方法
AI.findings: 儿童特征（特别是情感问题）比虐待性质和家庭状况更重要；照顾者特征最不重要；2005和2009年结果大致相似；所有模型解释力较低
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了多种统计方法在儿童保护决策研究中的稳健性，建立了2009年的新模型
AI.practical_contributions: 为儿童保护服务机构提供决策参考，强调需要关注儿童情感健康问题

title: Endorsements as a Trust Mechanism in the Context of AI
affiliations: Radboud University and iHub, Radboud University, Nijmegen

detail.title: Endorsements as a Trust Mechanism in the Context of AI
detail.abstract: AI-generated images, video, audio and text can undermine societal trust, leading to reality fatigue, and thus cause problems for democracy and national security. Europe’s AI Act aims to counter such developments by imposing transparency requirements for AI-generated content. This chapter proposes an alternative, more human-centred approach. We suggest that humans and organisations add digital endorsements to their content, whether such content is AI-generated or not. Such endorsements provide clarity about who says what, and clarify commitments, responsibilities, and liabilities. Endorsements can have legal effect. They may be implemented via digital signatures. Such signatures are a feature of the identity wallets that are being introduced in the European Union. Digital signatures are a valuable trust mechanism to stabilise our information space and to make it more robust.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过数字背书机制来应对AI生成内容带来的信任危机，建议人类和组织为其内容添加数字签名，明确责任归属，增强信息空间的稳定性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过数字背书机制解决AI生成内容对社会信任的破坏问题？
AI.motivation: AI生成的图像、视频、音频和文本可能破坏社会信任，导致现实疲劳，对民主和国家安全构成威胁。欧盟AI法案通过透明度要求来应对，但本文提出更以人为本的替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字信任机制和法律责任理论，强调通过数字签名实现内容来源的可追溯性和责任明确性。
AI.method: 提出数字背书机制，通过数字签名技术实现内容的责任归属和承诺明确，利用欧盟正在推行的身份钱包技术。
AI.findings: 数字背书可以为内容提供法律效力，明确谁说了什么，澄清承诺、责任和法律责任，是稳定信息空间的重要信任机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个以人为本的数字信任框架，超越了单纯的技术透明度要求，强调责任和承诺的法律效力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟AI法案提供了可行的实施路径，利用现有的数字身份基础设施，为信息空间的稳健性提供了具体的技术解决方案。

title: From Innovation to Application: Exploring the Phase-Differentiated Effects of Artificial Intelligence on Energy Efficiency
affiliations: Sichuan Normal University, Sichuan Normal University and Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE)

detail.title: From Innovation to Application: Exploring the Phase-Differentiated Effects of Artificial Intelligence on Energy Efficiency
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative force in economic and social systems, significantly affecting energy efficiency (EE). However, most studies treat AI as a uniform process, overlooking the potentially distinct effects of its development phases. This paper distinguishes between the AI innovation phase and the AI application phase, using panel data from 235 Chinese cities for 2012–2021. The results show that AI innovation significantly reduces EE, whereas AI application significantly enhances it. These effects remain robust across alternative EE measures and estimation methods. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that a low-carbon energy structure and higher human capital mitigate the adverse effect of AI innovation, while larger market size and stronger technology acceptance capacity strengthen the positive effect of AI application. Furthermore, fiscal science and technology expenditure and stronger intellectual property rights protection promote the transition from innovation to application. By introducing a phase-specific analytical perspective, this study helps explain the inconsistent findings in prior literature and underscores the need for differentiated policy strategies that target both the generation of AI innovations and their rapid diffusion, thereby enabling AI to evolve from an energy-intensive input into a catalyst for green transition.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了AI创新阶段和应用阶段，发现AI创新降低能源效率，而AI应用提升能源效率，强调了需要针对不同阶段制定差异化政策策略
AI.research_question: 人工智能的不同发展阶段（创新阶段和应用阶段）对能源效率的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 现有研究将AI视为统一过程，忽视了其不同发展阶段的潜在差异影响，导致文献中的发现不一致
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AI发展阶段性理论，区分AI创新阶段（技术研发）和AI应用阶段（技术扩散）对能源效率的不同影响机制
AI.method: 使用2012-2021年中国235个城市的面板数据，采用多种能源效率衡量方法和估计方法进行实证分析
AI.findings: AI创新显著降低能源效率，AI应用显著提升能源效率；低碳能源结构和更高人力资本缓解AI创新的负面影响，更大市场规模和更强技术接受能力增强AI应用的正面影响
AI.theory_contributions: 引入了阶段特异性分析视角，解释了先前文献中的不一致发现，深化了对AI发展不同阶段经济环境影响的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了需要针对AI创新生成和快速扩散制定差异化政策策略，促进AI从能源密集型投入向绿色转型催化剂的转变

title: Disparities in Household Carbon Emissions Across Urban–Rural and Regional Dimensions: Evidence from Large-Scale Field Surveys
affiliations: Lanzhou University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Southern Queensland, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - Northwest Institute of Eco-Environment and Resources, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - Northwest Institute of Eco-Environment and Resources, Lanzhou University, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - Northwest Institute of Eco-Environment and Resources, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - Northwest Institute of Eco-Environment and Resources, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - Northwest Institute of Eco-Environment and Resources and Lanzhou University

detail.title: Disparities in Household Carbon Emissions Across Urban–Rural and Regional Dimensions: Evidence from Large-Scale Field Surveys
detail.abstract: Using 5,585 household surveys from 108 Chinese cities in 2023, this study applies input-output analysis and machine learning to assess urban–rural and regional disparities in household carbon emissions (HCEs), quantify per-household and per-capita emissions, examine emission structures, and identify key drivers of HCEs. Key findings include: (1) Urban per-household HCEs (19.06 tCO2) are approximately 1.09 times those of rural areas (17.55 tCO2), and per-capita emissions show a 20% urban–rural gap (5.48 vs. 4.56 tCO2). (2) Indirect HCEs dominate per-household emissions, contributing 68.59% (12.72 tCO2), versus 31.41% (5.83 tCO2) from direct HCEs. (3) Housing, transportation and communications (indirect emissions from production), electricity, miscellaneous goods and services, and private vehicle energy consumption (direct emissions) together account for 51.99% of total HCEs. (4) The southern coastal and northeast regions record the highest emissions, while the northwest and mid-Yangtze River regions have the lowest levels. The eastern coastal and mid-Yangtze River regions show proportionally higher emissions from food and household electricity consumption. Interregional disparities have narrowed over the past decade. (5) Household size and generational structure significantly influence HCEs, with asset holding factors driving growth. Daily consumption factors, especially transport and electricity, now represent 54.03% of feature importance. The findings suggest a need for targeted interventions: direct HCEs may be reduced through appliance upgrades, off-grid renewable energy systems, and energy literacy initiatives, while indirect HCEs require policies promoting green mobility, sustainable housing, and low-carbon lifestyles. The growing impact of utilities and private transport also underscores the value of behavioral nudges and shared transport incentives.

AI.tldr: 基于2023年中国108个城市的5585户家庭调查数据，本研究运用投入产出分析和机器学习方法，揭示了城乡和区域间家庭碳排放差异。主要发现：城市家庭碳排放比农村高9%，人均排放差距达20%；间接排放占主导地位(68.59%)；住房、交通通信、电力等是主要排放源；南部沿海和东北地区排放最高；家庭规模和代际结构显著影响排放。
AI.research_question: 中国城乡和区域间家庭碳排放存在哪些差异？影响家庭碳排放的关键驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解家庭碳排放的城乡和区域差异对于制定针对性的碳减排政策至关重要，但目前缺乏基于大规模调查数据的系统分析
AI.theoretical_framework: 投入产出分析理论、家庭消费碳排放理论、区域差异理论
AI.method: 使用5585户家庭调查数据，结合投入产出分析和机器学习方法，量化家庭碳排放并识别关键驱动因素
AI.findings: 1)城市家庭碳排放比农村高9%，人均差距20%；2)间接排放占主导(68.59%)；3)住房、交通等五大领域占排放总量52%；4)南部沿海和东北排放最高；5)家庭规模和资产持有是重要影响因素
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了结合投入产出和机器学习的家庭碳排放分析框架，揭示了城乡和区域差异的新特征
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定差异化的碳减排政策提供依据：直接排放可通过设备升级和可再生能源减少，间接排放需要绿色交通和低碳生活方式政策

title: Volatility Calibration via Automatic Local Regression
affiliations: University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign - Department of Industrial and Enterprise Systems Engineering, JP Morgan & Chase and University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign

detail.title: Volatility Calibration via Automatic Local Regression
detail.abstract: Managing exotic derivatives requires accurate mark-to-market pricing and stable Greeks for reliable hedging. The Local Volatility (LV) model distinguishes itself from other pricing models by its ability to match observable market prices across all strikes and maturities with high accuracy. However, LV calibration is fundamentally ill-posed: finite market observables must determine a continuouslydefined surface with infinite local volatility parameters. This ill-posed nature often causes spiky LV surfaces that are particularly problematic for finite-difference-based valuation, and induces highfrequency oscillations in solutions, thus leading to unstable Greeks. To address this challenge, we propose a pre-calibration smoothing method that can be integrated seamlessly into any LV calibration workflow. Our method pre-processes market observables using local regression that automatically minimizes asymptotic conditional mean squared error to generate denoised inputs for subsequent LV calibration. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed pre-calibration smoothing yields significantly smoother LV surfaces and greatly improves Greek stability for exotic options with negligible additional computational cost, while preserving the LV model's ability to fit market observables with high fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种预校准平滑方法，通过局部回归预处理市场观测值，解决了局部波动率模型校准中的不适定问题，显著提高了波动率表面的平滑度和希腊值的稳定性。
AI.research_question: 如何解决局部波动率模型校准中的不适定问题，以获得更平滑的波动率表面和更稳定的希腊值？
AI.motivation: 局部波动率模型虽然能够精确匹配市场观测价格，但其校准过程本质上是病态的，有限的观测值需要确定无限个局部波动率参数，导致波动率表面出现尖峰，影响有限差分估值和希腊值的稳定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于局部波动率模型的理论框架，结合局部回归方法进行数据预处理，通过最小化渐近条件均方误差来降噪。
AI.method: 提出预校准平滑方法，使用局部回归预处理市场观测值，生成降噪后的输入数据，然后进行局部波动率校准。
AI.findings: 数值实验表明，该方法能显著提高局部波动率表面的平滑度，大幅改善奇异期权的希腊值稳定性，且计算成本可忽略不计，同时保持对市场观测值的高精度拟合能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 为解决局部波动率模型校准的病态问题提供了理论框架和方法论，丰富了金融衍生品定价模型的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了实用的预校准平滑工具，能够提高奇异衍生品的定价准确性和对冲稳定性，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Organizational Conflict: An Analysis of Conflict in the Workplace
affiliations: The Chicago School of Professional Psychology

detail.title: Organizational Conflict: An Analysis of Conflict in the Workplace

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This paper is a white paper on Organizational conflict

detail.abstract: This paper examines the nature, causes, and impacts of organizational conflict in the workplace. Conflict arises from factors such as goal incompatibility, task interdependence, limited resources, role ambiguity, and cultural differences during mergers and acquisitions. While conflict can foster knowledge transfer and decision-making in some contexts, it often leads to negative outcomes including reduced employee satisfaction, turnover, and decreased organizational performance. The study highlights the complex effects of social and cultural conflict on knowledge sharing and collaboration, emphasizing that organizational cultural differences are more influential than national cultural variations. Research findings further demonstrate that conflict influences team performance differently depending on context, with task conflict sometimes aiding decision-making but hindering project and production teams. Survey evidence from employees also indicates widespread dissatisfaction with conflict resolution methods, underscoring the need for effective management practices. Finally, the paper explores conflict management styles—integrating, dominating, compromising, avoiding, and obliging—and how gender and organizational status influence their use. Understanding these dynamics is essential for developing strategies that not only resolve disputes but also harness conflict constructively to improve organizational outcomes.

title: Full Automation is Not Always Preferred: Drivers’ Situational Acceptance of Driving Automation
affiliations: Delft University of Technology, Universidad Politécnica de Madrid (UPM) and Delft University of Technology

detail.title: Full Automation is Not Always Preferred: Drivers’ Situational Acceptance of Driving Automation
detail.abstract: Research on human-automated vehicle interaction has focused on safety and user experience across different levels of automation. However, for a user-centred automation design, we shall also consider whether drivers desire the most advanced level of driving automation in every driving situation. To address this gap, this study investigates drivers’ preferences for manual, assisted, and automated driving across three distinct driving scenarios: highway, construction zone, and school zone. Adopting a mixed-method approach, we collected measures of driver intervention, trust, perceived risk, mental workload, and preference through a combination of a driving simulator, questionnaires, and interviews. Results show that trust and perceived risk are shaped more by scenario complexity than by driving automation level, with trust highest and perceived risk lowest on highways. Driving automation reduces mental workload overall, but assisted driving occasionally imposes greater cognitive demands due to the monitoring responsibility. Preferences are context-dependent, with drivers preferring automated driving on highways but manual driving in school zones. Interview data revealed diverse attitudes toward automation, influenced by perception of safety, control, and system transparency. Adaptive systems that offer transparent communication, situational awareness, and user agency in mode transitions may improve trust and acceptance. This research provides empirical insights for the development of automated vehicles that dynamically align system behaviour with driver needs and environmental demands.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过混合方法研究发现，驾驶员对自动驾驶的偏好具有情境依赖性，高速公路偏好自动化驾驶，学校区域偏好手动驾驶。信任和风险感知更多受场景复杂性影响而非自动化水平，自适应系统需要提供透明沟通和用户控制权。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人机交互理论、信任理论、风险感知理论和认知负荷理论，探讨自动化水平与驾驶场景对驾驶员心理状态和行为偏好的影响。
AI.method: 采用混合方法，结合驾驶模拟器实验、问卷调查和访谈，测量驾驶员干预行为、信任水平、风险感知、心理负荷和偏好选择。
AI.findings: 1) 信任和风险感知更多受场景复杂性影响，高速公路信任最高风险最低；2) 自动化降低心理负荷，但辅助驾驶因监控责任偶尔增加认知需求；3) 偏好具有情境依赖性，高速公路偏好自动化，学校区域偏好手动驾驶；4) 访谈显示态度受安全感知、控制感和系统透明度影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了人车交互理论，揭示了驾驶偏好情境依赖性的心理机制，丰富了自动化接受度理论中环境因素的作用理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为开发自适应自动驾驶系统提供实证依据，建议系统设计应包含透明沟通、情境感知和模式转换中的用户自主权，以提升信任和接受度。

title: Operational Excellence in Manufacturing: Bridging Industry Best Practices and Leadership Experience

detail.title: Operational Excellence in Manufacturing: Bridging Industry Best Practices and Leadership Experience
detail.abstract: This paper examines operational excellence in manufacturing by integrating proven industry methodologies with real-world leadership experience. It explores how Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement frameworks, when combined with strong people leadership, can enhance efficiency, quality, and resilience. Case studies from Toyota, Nike, General Electric, and Alcoa are presented alongside the author's practical leadership experience at Amazon, Givi Vietnam, and packaging firms. Topics covered include efficiency through Lean Six Sigma, quality management and global certifications, workforce engagement and safety culture, resilience in the face of disruptions such as COVID-19, and the role of data-driven decision making. The analysis demonstrates that operational excellence is not a static achievement but a continuous pursuit requiring integration of process discipline, leadership vision, and adaptability.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过整合精盛生产、六西格马等行业方法论与实际领导经验，探讨了如何在制造业实现运营卓越。研究发现运营卓越需要过程纪律、领导力和适应性的结合，是一个持续的追求而非静态成就。
AI.research_question: 如何通过整合精盛生产、六西格马等行业方法论与实际领导经验来实现制造业运营卓越？
AI.motivation: 探索行业已验证的方法论与实践领导经验的结合，以提升制造业的效率、质量和弹性能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 精盛生产(Lean)、六西格马(Six Sigma)、持续改进框架以及人员领导理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，分析了估田、耐克、通用电气、阿尔科尼亚等公司的实例，以及作者在亚马逊、Givi越南和包装公司的实践经验。
AI.findings: 运营卓越需要精盛六西格马的效率提升、质量管理咈全球认证、员工参与和安全文化、面对如COVID-19等干扰的弹性能力，以及数据驱动的决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 强调了运营卓越作为一种持续追求的动态过程，而非静态成就，并提供了过程纪律、领导视野和适应性相结合的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制造业企业提供了实践指南，包括如何通过精盛六西格马提升效率、建立质量管理体系、培养员工参与和安全文化、应对干扰的弹性策略以及基于数据的决策方法。
